I answered Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations.

- **Where it comes from:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again. It was the morning shift: the same trailer showed up twice at 06:30 because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him by hand. Marcus is in that channel, so this is something they could see themselves.
- **Thea's title:** this comes from a North team cheat sheet in the notes, not from the channel.
- **Not shared:** the Quarrendon account folder came back empty, so I couldn't check a CRM record. I said Dana owns the account and will have the latest. I left out the seat count that appeared in the same Aug 20 messages because Marcus didn't ask for it.
